content: युध् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (युध्यते, युद्ध) .²1 To fight, struggle, contend with, wage war; योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः <ls>Bg. 1. 23</ls>; <ls>Bk. 5. 101</ls>. .²2 To conquer or overcome in fight. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (योधयति-ते) .²1 To cause to fight. .²2 To oppose or encounter in fight with; सा बाणवर्षिणं रामं योधयित्वा सुरद्विषाम् <ls>R. 12. 50</ls>. .²3 To vanquish, conquer. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (युयुत्सते) To wish to fight. --{%With%} नि to wrestle, box. -प्रति to encounter in fight, oppose.
युध् {%f.%} War, battle, fight, contest; निघातयिष्यन् युधि यातुधानान् <ls>Bk. 2. 21</ls>; सदसि वाक्पटुता युधि विक्रमः <ls>Bh. 2. 63</ls>; <ls>Mb. 5. 23. 20</ls>. --{%m.%} A hero, soldier.
